column1: # Known gaps of the new runtime's side (`conformance replay --rt`): the rows `known-gaps.tsv` holds
# for the old runtime's, in its format and under its rules, held to a replay of the new runtime
# (`metal2vulkan-rt`) in both directions, per venue. A call the side does not answer yet is a
# refusal of `Unavailable` naming the call ([`rt_side`](src/rt_side.rs)), and a row here until the
# side answers it. The old runtime's rows stay in `known-gaps.tsv` and are not held to this side.
